# Registration Automation

This page documents the intended registration automation structure. It is implementation-ready, but it does not include private credentials, API keys, or live payment links.

## Intended Workflow

```text
Quarto website
↓
Google Form pre-registration
↓
Google Sheets participant database
↓
PayPal payment
↓
Payment confirmation
↓
Google Sheets update
↓
Gmail/gmailr confirmation email
↓
Discord/Telegram invitation
```

## Google Sheets Schema

Recommended columns:

```text
timestamp
full_name
email
phone
country
course_selected
preferred_channel
payment_status
payment_id
amount_paid
payment_date
confirmation_email_sent
community_invite_sent
notes
```

## Automation Notes

- Google Forms should write pre-registration responses to Google Sheets.
- PayPal payment links should be created separately for each course.
- Payment status can be updated manually at first, then automated later through PayPal exports or an approved integration.
- Confirmation emails should only be sent when `payment_status` is `paid` and `confirmation_email_sent` is not `yes`.
- Community invitations should be sent after payment confirmation.
